title: SQL injection in transaction lookup
description: get_transactions() builds a SQL statement with an f-string from the 'account' query parameter of /api/transactions. An attacker can read every account's transactions with account=' OR '1'='1.

title: Path traversal in receipt download
description: /api/receipts joins the 'file' query parameter to the receipts directory without normalising it. file=../not_a_secret.txt reads sample-app/data/not_a_secret.txt outside the receipts directory.

title: Over-permissioned service account (roles/editor)
description: Terraform grants roles/editor on the project to payment-service-sa, the runtime identity of the internet-facing payment-service Cloud Run service. The service only needs to read its own receipts bucket.

title: Outdated base image python:3.8-slim-buster
description: The image is built FROM python:3.8-slim-buster. Python 3.8 and Debian 10 (buster) are end of life; the image carries OS packages with known critical CVEs (for example CVE-2022-37434 in zlib1g).

title: Hard-coded placeholder API key in config
description: DEFAULT_API_KEY is set to a literal string. Replaced with an environment variable read in a later commit.

title: Possible reflected XSS in search page
description: The search term is rendered in the page. The template engine escapes it; the sandbox PoC did not reproduce. Marked false positive.

title: Outbound HTTP request without timeout
description: requests.post() is called without a timeout; a slow endpoint can hang the worker.

title: Outdated dependency pin (urllib3)
description: urllib3 is pinned to an old minor version. No exploitable path found; upgrade during normal maintenance.
